name: Fort Myers Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Fort Myers Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes; plain golf carts only where the town designates roads, and none were found. In Fort Myers Beach, registered LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less, including Estero Boulevard.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
No motor vehicles on sidewalks or shared paths
rules.citation: Town of Fort Myers Beach Ord. 25-03

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Estero Boulevard in Fort Myers Beach?
faq.a: Yes, where it's posted 35 mph or less, which is most of it. Registered LSVs follow the Florida LSV law.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Fort Myers Beach?
faq.a: Only on roads the town has designated and signed for golf carts. We didn't find any, so plan on an LSV.
